mechanism_narrative: Steady week-over-week recovery in TRANSIT from -33.6 to -28.0 signals restored out-of-home routines; commuters resume discretionary stops en route, lifting RETAIL_REC above its trailing 28-day mean of -35.4 within four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -33.6 at t-2w to -28.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: The next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to -35.4 while TRANSIT continues to improve week-over-week.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS weekly means climb from +6.6 to +11.9 and breach the +10 level; warm-weather outdoor trips cluster around retail-adjacent corridors, so RETAIL_REC rises above the prior 28-day mean within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises above +10.0 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS reached +11.9 at t-0w after +6.6 at t-2w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls below its trailing 28-day mean in the two weeks after PARKS holds above +10.0.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rebounded from -41.6 at t-2w to -34.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its trailing 28-day mean when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise together for two consecutive weeks, or rises equally when only one of them rises.

mechanism_narrative: A WORKPLACES weekly mean at or below -40.0 marks policy-driven restriction re-imposition, as observed at t-2w; offices empty and discretionary retail trips are curtailed, pushing RETAIL_REC below its trailing mean within two weeks.

failure_condition: After a WORKPLACES weekly mean at or below -40.0, the following 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is higher than its trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL persistence above +5.0 keeps a measurable share of household time at home; the elevated home-stay baseline suppresses trip chaining and drives RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean over four weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL held between +5.4 and +6.0 across all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next 28-day mean exceeds its trailing 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above +5.0 for three straight weeks.

failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS and TRANSIT both rise, RETAIL_REC's 7-day forward mean is no higher than its 7-day trailing mean.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week TRANSIT drop larger than 4 points marks renewed policy tightening on movement; transit-dependent discretionary trips are cut first, dragging RETAIL_REC below its trailing mean within one week.

fact:RETAIL_REC fell 3.2 points from t-3w to t-2w in the same window
failure_condition: A TRANSIT weekly drop greater than 4.0 points is followed by a 7-day RETAIL_REC mean at or above its 7-day trailing mean.
